description: This file defines the ControllerFactory class responsible for creating and returning instances of controller classes based on the module name. It includes logic for loading custom or standard module controllers, and sets up the controller instance.

classes.name: ControllerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for obtaining controller instances based on module name.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns an instance of the appropriate controller class for the specified module, loading custom or default controllers as needed.
